tagline: Prime real estate for sustainable value creation
hero_kpi_rationale: Gross rental income like-for-like growth is the primary driver of operational performance for Colonial, reflecting its ability to increase rents across its prime portfolio, particularly in Paris. This is a key indicator of internal growth dynamics in the listed real estate sector.
company_description: Colonial SFL, Socimi S. A. is the leading platform in Europe's prime commercial real estate market, with a presence in the main business districts of Barcelona, Madrid, and Paris. It boasts a unique portfolio totaling more than 1 million euros, with a market value exceeding 12 billion euros. The Group follows a dedicated, long-term strategy focused on value creation through a high-quality client portfolio and asset appreciation. Looking ahead, Colonial SFL will continue to lead the urban transformation of city centers in the European market, recognized for its experience and professionalism, financial strength and profitability, while providing excellent sustainable real estate solutions adapted to the needs of its clients.

kpis.name: Gross rental income like-for-like growth
kpis.explanation: Increase in rental income on a like-for-like basis, excluding foreign exchange and new asset effects.
kpis.description: 6% like-for-like growth in gross rental income, driven by strong momentum in Paris (+9%).
kpis.signal: Strong organic growth among the highest in the sector

kpis.name: Lease reletting spread
kpis.explanation: Difference between new rents signed and previous lease rates for relet spaces.
kpis.description: Average spread of +8% at group level, reaching +16% in Paris, indicating strong demand for prime assets.
kpis.signal: Enhanced pricing power in the leasing market

kpis.name: Occupancy rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of leased space within the real estate portfolio.
kpis.description: Overall occupancy rate of 92%, up 62 basis points compared to September 2025.
kpis.signal: High occupancy rate, showing continuous improvement

kpis.name: Gross asset value like-for-like growth
kpis.explanation: Change in real estate asset values on a like-for-like basis.
kpis.description: 3% like-for-like growth in gross asset value, supported by rising rents and portfolio quality.

kpis.name: Loan to value ratio
kpis.explanation: Net debt outstanding divided by asset value.
kpis.description: Pro forma LTV at 37.1%, down 105 basis points, thanks to the disposal program.
kpis.signal: Ongoing deleveraging, strengthened balance sheet structure

kpis.name: Disposals completed
kpis.explanation: Value of assets sold under the divestment program.
kpis.description: 300 million euros of disposals completed year-to-date, including 240 million euros in Paris (83 Marceau).
kpis.signal: Accelerated execution of the deleveraging program
